notes.title: Big Update + 50% Off!
notes.content:
I've released a new update to Way of the Red which improves many things that had been rushed or sloppily implemented upon release. This update includes:

[list]
[*]A new boss at the end of the Arid Wastes zone
[*]Boss life bars
[*]A minigame located in the Arid Wastes town
[*]Improvements to the glitchy movement of wolf enemies
[*]Improved boss AI and tweaking of their stats to prevent weird reactions with walls and/or strange behavior in general
[*]Fixed minor bugs brought to my attention by the players, this includes some out-of-bounds collision issues
[/list]

I've also posted a no-commentary walkthrough of the game here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LmlY70gWYak&index=1&list=PLD92NDrh0GLyicuBHTHVj90LwpusnDIMs

Along with this patch, the price of the game has been reduced by half. Thanks for playing Way of the Red!

notes.title: Update Notes: 11 19 2016
notes.content:
Hello everyone. Due to all the excellent feedback, I've released a substantial update to WotR. Here is a breakdown of what has changed:
[list][*] Added more save points to the game overall. Now, on average, there is one save point per room, whereas before there were many difficult areas with save points 2-4 rooms apart.

[*] You can now move with the dpad as well as the analog stick if you so desire. Thanks to user pook99 for suggesting this. Don't know why I didn't think of it!

[*] Gave more obvious hints about where you're supposed to go in the first zone. Many people were confused about this area and ended up running around for a very long time trying to figure out where to go/what to do.

[*] Climbing is now slightly faster.[/list]

There will probably be more updates to come in the future. If you've already beaten the game, I hope you enjoyed it, and I hope these little flaws didn't get in the way too much before I was able to fix them. Thanks for your reviews, kind words, and patience.
